title: LearnOps course model (B2, v1)
description: DRAFT: freeze candidate for Release 0, pending the required approvals and merge. Not yet approved or frozen. Confirmed decisions and open items are recorded in docs/decisions/0003-b2-course-model.md. Items that are still unresolved are listed only in section 3 of that record, so a field is settled only when the record says so. A normalised JSON description of a course, read by the checker and built from a Moodle backup (.mbz) or a course package (PRD B2). It describes what a course IS, including a broken course, so that the checker can report the problem. This schema checks structure only and must never reject a course-design error.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, A9, EXT-02). A null means the source does not carry the value, for example a package has no Moodle visibility setting, or that the item does not exist, as stated on each field. For visible and completion_enabled, null never means false, and the checker treats it as cannot judge, not as a fault. Deliberately NOT enforced here, because a course that breaks them must still validate so that a rule can report it: unique or well-formed idnumbers (CK-06), protected items (CK-07), points summing to the target (CK-03), references inside availability, criteria or badges pointing at real activities (CK-04, CK-08), circular unlock rules (CK-05), completion rules that can be met (CK-02), a valid marking table with matching points (CK-09), marking workflow being on (CK-10), H5P having no grade item (CK-11), relative media paths (CK-12), and completion tracking on activities used in unlock rules (CK-13). The inner form of availability belongs to Moodle and is not described here. Unique cmid values are not enforced either; the model builder guarantees them. CK-07 compares protected items field by field against a supplied reference model of the template course, using the same comparison as FR-C-05; there are no fingerprints. The model holds no body text or attached files, so a change to those cannot be seen.

schema.description: Contract name and version. Changing this value is a breaking change requiring v2.

badges.description: null when the source does not carry them: a package never does (PRD B1.4). An empty array means the source carries badges and has none.

idnumber.description: As found in the source, with no format check, because invalid and duplicate values are what CK-06 reports. null when there is none. Protected idnumbers are allowed, because CK-07 needs to see them (unlike B1, which rejects them).

visible.description: null means the source does not say, as in a package. It never means false: the checker treats it as cannot judge, not as a fault.

availability.description: Provisional until Moodle lab verification (decision 0003 section 4, items 1 and 2): the cm = -1 resolution described below is documented, not verified on Moodle 4.5 or 5.3. Moodle's own availability JSON, kept whole so that no information is lost (PRD B2). null means no restriction. A package unlock rule is stored as an availability object too, with its date as a Unix timestamp for 00:00 in the configured site timezone (see source.timezone). The contract does not fix the inner structure of an availability object (its operator, condition list, show flags, condition values and their order belong to Moodle), and the examples are illustrations only, so a reader finds conditions by their type, never by position. In completion conditions, cm = -1 means OPTION_PREVIOUS: the nearest earlier activity in course order with manual or automatic completion tracking; for a section's availability, earlier means strictly before that section. Activities without tracking are skipped. If no eligible activity exists, the condition cannot be met. An unresolved -1 is reported as CK-04.

cmid.description: Moodle course-module ID used to reference an activity. Never compare CMIDs between models; idnumber is the stable identity. Package-derived models use synthetic positive CMIDs numbered from 1 in document order. Never use 0 or -1. Synthetic CMIDs are local to their own model.

source.description: Where the model came from. Kind is mbz or package. Mode and timezone are described on their own fields.

mode.description: The output mode, full or sections-only. The values come from PRD B1.4 and are confirmed (decision 0003 #22). It is required for every source, as the conditional rules on source.kind below require: a package source may use full or sections-only, and a .mbz source must use full, because a backup represents a whole course and its output mode is therefore full. CK-07 needs the mode because a sections-only package leaves out protected items on purpose.

timezone.description: The configured site timezone used to convert package dates to 00:00, for example Asia/Kolkata for the lab. A package source requires a non-empty string and an mbz source requires null. Those requirements come from the conditional if/then rules on source.kind, not from this property alone; minLength 1 rejects an empty string. A JSON Schema cannot tell whether a time-zone name is recognised, so validate_course_model() in libs/contracts also checks at run time that Python zoneinfo.ZoneInfo resolves a non-empty name. A model builder gets the value of a package model from site_timezone(os.environ), which reads SITE_TIMEZONE. There is no default timezone: a missing or invalid setting is an error (decision 0003 #20).

fullname.description: Optional, reporting only. A Moodle course always has a full name and B1 requires one, so it is never null. Section and activity titles may be null because the source may not name them.

completion_enabled.description: Course-level completion tracking. null means the source does not say, as in a package. It never means false: the checker treats it as cannot judge, not as a fault.

total_points.description: Optional independent course points target. For package sources, when absent or null, CK-03 uses the B1 default of 100. For .mbz sources, this value is populated only when an independent target is supplied to the model builder (for example, the declared total for a merged course); it must never be derived from the computed gradebook total. If no independent target is available, leave it absent or null and CK-03 returns cannot judge. The schema describes this value but does not enforce CK-03.

number.description: Moodle's section number. The schema permits 0; whether Moodle 4.5 and 5.3 source backups use section 0 remains pending Moodle lab item 5 (decision 0003, section 4).

idnumber.description: Nullable section identity. Moodle course_sections has no idnumber field, so mbz-derived models use null (the guide read the Moodle 4.5 and 5.3 source: issue #65, comment of 2026-11-12). Sections are matched by section number.

activities.description: In course order. May be empty.

completion.description: The activity's completion rule. A rule that can never be met must still validate (CK-02).

tracking.description: Completion tracking mode: none (Moodle value 0), manual (Moodle value 1), or automatic (Moodle value 2).

use_grade.description: Complete when a grade is received.

pass_grade.description: Complete only with a passing grade.

grade_item.description: null means no grade item. This also answers whether an H5P activity is graded (PRD B2, CK-11).

max_grade.description: Maximum grade. A number, not restricted to an integer. How CK-03 compares non-integer points is undecided (decision 0003 section 3).

marking_table.description: Marking table summary with present and points_total. It does not contain a valid field; marking-table validity is checked by CK-09.

points_total.description: Sum of the table's Points column. null when there is no table or it cannot be parsed.

type.description: page, assignment, url, label or h5p (the B1 names). Moodle module names map to B1 names as: assign -> assignment, h5pactivity -> h5p, page -> page, url -> url, label -> label. The raw Moodle aliases assign and h5pactivity are rejected, so each of these activities has exactly one spelling. The builder maps the name before any rule is applied, so a source assign is checked as assignment, including the marking fields the schema requires for assignment. Any other type keeps Moodle's module name unchanged (for example quiz) and is reported as not checked, never silently skipped (PRD C2.8), so this is not an enum.

marking_workflow.description: null when the source does not carry it, as in a package.

media_refs.description:
Optional. Every in-scope embedded-media reference found in the activity body, as written, including absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs, relative paths, Moodle @@PLUGINFILE@@/... references and data: URIs. Each URL in an srcset attribute is recorded as a separate entry, without its descriptor.

v1 scope: Markdown images (inline and reference-style); HTML img (src, srcset), video (src, poster), audio (src), source (src, srcset) and track (src), in activity bodies, including raw HTML inside a Markdown body and HTML bodies from .mbz backups.

Ordinary links (including PDF links) and iframe embeds are outside the v1 scope: they are not listed or checked.

CK-12 flagging is a separate rule. In v1, relative paths, Moodle @@PLUGINFILE@@/... references and data: URIs are not flagged. The handling of other URI schemes remains an open decision.

Empty means no in-scope references were found. If absent, CK-12 cannot judge the activity's media references.

criterion.description: One course-completion or badge criterion. CK-08 reports a criterion that refers to a missing item, so the reference is not checked here.

type.description: The kind of criterion, for example activity. Open, because Moodle has several.

cmid.description: The activity referred to, as found in the source. It may not exist in this model.

idnumber.description: The referred activity's idnumber, when the builder can resolve it.

course_completion.description: null when the source does not carry it: a package never does (PRD B1.4).
